title: French Bread
wikitext: {{Legacy}} {{Infobox/Item |type = Item |id = FRENCH_BREAD |rarity = Special |auctionable = Yes |museum = yes |museum_xp = 0 |museum_category = special }} The '''French Bread''' is a {{Special}} [[Memento]]. It was added to the game after many users spammed each message with French Bread reactions in the [https://discord.gg/hypixel Hypixel Discord Server] after the #admin-lounge channel, which was renamed to #⭐mvp-lounge⭐, was opened to {{Rank|MVP++}} and above. It currently has no function in the game other than for decoration purposes. == Obtaining == The '''French Bread''' was only obtainable by defeating {{MobSprite|Bonzo}} or {{MobSprite|Scarf}} on the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] during testing, and it was delivered to the player's personal island via [[Jerry]]. Players are unable to obtain this item directly, except for YouTubers, Hypixel Player Council, Staff and {{Rank|MVP++}} who had access to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]]. == Trivia == *Players who defeated both {{MobSprite|Bonzo}} and {{MobSprite|Scarf}} on the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] received {{Green|2}} '''French Breads'''. == Gallery == French Bread Description.png|Current Description French Bread Capture.png|Original Description == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/July 7|[[File:French Bread.png|26px]] Added '''French Bread'''.}} {{History|2024/July 2|'''French Bread''' is now a memento.|'''French Bread''' can no longer be sold to NPCs.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Special Items}} [[Category:Hypixel Gifts]]
